desc: Parse the input: read N, M, Sx, Sy, the list of house coordinates, and the list of moves.
Preprocess houses into two dictionaries: `houses_by_x` (X -> set of Ys) and `houses_by_y` (Y -> set of Xs) for efficient range-like queries.
Initialize `visited_houses` as an empty set to keep track of unique houses encountered.
Update current position (cx, cy) for each move.
Determine the segment bounds (min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y).
If horizontal (dy=0), look up `houses_by_y[cy]` and check which Xs in that set fall within [min_x, max_x]. Add unvisited houses to `visited_houses`.
If vertical (dx=0), look up `houses_by_x[cx]` and check which Ys in that set fall within [min_y, max_y]. Add unvisited houses to `visited_houses`.
Print the final (cx, cy) and the length of `visited_houses`.
